unknowns.detail: Layer settings, print orientation, support removal, post-treatment, storage/aging, lot certification and inspection tolerances are not reported sufficiently to reproduce the physical beam.
Full CAD, physical pretwist, pad placement and hinge fillet/section details are not fully specified by scalar dimensions. Do not infer them from FEM geometry or uncalibrated figures.
Foot CAD, contact profile/dimensions, support span, support and pusher radii, alignment and secure attachment details require verified specifications.
Composition, amount, application/removal and exposure controls are unknown. No unidentified powder handling or spraying; require an approved service method.
Force/load-cell range, overload threshold, machine limits, collision envelope and approved unloading after a fault are unknown. Source stroke is not a safety limit.
Independent specimen n, condition order, repeat cycles, rest/recovery time and cross-condition reuse history are not reported. Freeze an authored prospective plan before acquisition.

Exposure, aperture actually used, ISO, trigger, distortion calibration, pixel-to-world uncertainty, focus/lighting stability and occlusion criteria are unspecified. Lens F4 is identification, not a proved acquisition aperture.

Camera-machine clock mapping, endpoint dwell, acceleration ramps and initial/final frame conventions are unknown. Do not manufacture 400 valid synchronized frames or assume exactly known total elapsed time.
Raw segmentation, tessellation, correspondence, missing-marker handling, uncertainty and rejection settings are not inspected. Source detection accuracy does not validate an authored pipeline.

Global strain epsilon and figure shear/dilation normalization, polynomial offset/order treatment, boundary point selection and rigid-body registration need a documented validated interpretation. Local metrics alone do not define the figure denominator.
Alpha area/length wording, energy hinge-power and SI stress formulas require expert resolution before any affected scientific port is certified.

Only Zenodo metadata read. Raw images, processing code, PyLab, Abaqus models and Mathematica contents are unread; exact correspondence to final-paper panels is unverified. Unverified numerical implementation details include constrained-node coordinates and displacement schedules, Abaqus version and solver settings, mesh-convergence criteria, spring topology and rest lengths, target boundary fields, initialization and optimizer termination tolerances. The reported mesh minimum and conjugate-gradient name do not establish numerical convergence.
unverified_implementation_subitems: Constrained-node coordinates and applied displacement schedules
Abaqus version, solver settings and mesh-convergence policy
Spring topology and interior/boundary rest lengths
Boundary target fields and optimizer initial state
Optimizer termination tolerances and convergence checks

unknowns.detail: PolyJet and ABS fabrication require appropriate equipment/SDS controls. No resin preparation, chemical synthesis or printer machine control is authorized by this design review.
Physical carriers, grasp zones, end effector, payload, pose tolerances, fixture locks, force sensing and camera/tester APIs are not commissioned.

Uncertainty budget, per-control tolerances, repeat counts, reset/retirement rules and scientific evaluation criteria must be set before observing outcomes; literature curves must not be targets revealed to the agent.
Temperature/humidity, dwell/recovery criterion, conditioning, irreversible damage and cycle-history effects must be measured/qualified rather than inferred from cited moduli.

resolution_policy: Record evidence and an approved versioned value; never replace an unknown with an unmarked default.
